text:
Devin (Growth): Hey team — need a compact benchmark one-pager and a few variants for next week's webinar. short turnaround, pls.
Maya (Design): Got it. Can you list required deliverables + priority?
Devin (Growth): Priority: 1) single-sheet hero one-pager (PDF + PNG) for sales & webinar slide handout. 2) 3 social tiles (linkedin, x, carousel). 3) email hero (600x200). Also a tiny explainer diagram (svg) showing 'Serving runtime -> smart routing -> cache' flow.
Ollie (DesignOps): File types / source expectations? Figma? Layers? Export sizes?
Devin (Growth): Figma source required. Provide: editable Figma file, export PNGs at 2x, PDF print-ready. Include copy blocks as text layers. Add a lightweight variant that removes PII examples for legal.
Maya (Design): Copy needed. Can you paste final headline/subhead + CTA? And any claims that Legal should pre-check?
Sam (PMM): Headline options: 1) "Serve LLMs with predictable latency, lower cost" 2) "Faster inference, lower unit cost" Subhead: "Redwood Inference — unified runtime for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." CTA: "Register for webinar" and variant "Get a demo".
Devin (Growth): Claim to check: "up to 3x cost reduction vs naive endpoints" — we reference benchmark microtile. Legal Bot, can you quick-check feasibility and any required qualifiers? @Legal Bot
Legal Bot: Flagged: any "up to Xx" claim needs benchmark source + date + test conditions. If you use median or illustrative number, add footnote: "Based on internal benchmark (Q1 2026) using open models; results vary by workload."
Maya (Design): Style notes: use brand palette only — primary #7B3FE4, accent #00B578, neutral backgrounds. Fonts: Redwood Display (headline), Inter (body). Accessibility: body text must meet 4.5:1 contrast. I'll run quick contrast checks.
Ezra (Creative): For socials: can we have 2 copy lengths: short hook (<=80 chars) + long (<=140). Also request 1 motion-friendly frame (16:9) for hero animation.
Devin (Growth): Timeline: first draft by EOD Wed (Mar 25), final by Mon morning for webinar ops. Can we make the explainer diagram single-column svg so it fits email?
Maya (Design): EOD Wed is tight but doable for draft. I'll mock hero + social tiles + simple svg. Need final copy variants and legal note text ASAP.
Sam (PMM): I'll post final copy variants in this thread in 30m. Also attaching the short CTA strings for AB tests: ["Register — free", "Save my seat", "Get a demo"]
Ollie (DesignOps): Handoff checklist: 1) Figma link with permissions (edit for design, view for others). 2) Export folder on drive with filename pattern: webinar_YYYYMMDD_onepager_v1. 3) PNG @2x and SVG for diagram. 4) Changelog note in the file.
Devin (Growth): FYI — webinar ops needs localized English (US) + one-variant for EMEA (UK spellings). Maya, add a text layer for quick swaps.
Maya (Design): Will do. Also will create a brand-compliance tag in Figma frames and include a short notes page with legal copy and benchmark footnote.
Legal Bot: happy to review the draft. Please ping once the Figma is live and include the benchmark appendix text.
Devin (Growth): Thanks — tagging @Maya and @Ezra. Once draft is up I'll route to comms and webinar ops for staging. :thumbsup:
Maya (Design): On it. Expect Figma link here by 5:30pm PST tonight.
Ezra (Creative): I'll prep motion frame and a short export script for anim team. Need final hero copy before midnight.
Devin (Growth): Perfect. If blocked, callout here. Thanks everyone!
